Automatic: Python wrapper around Codex CLI in isolated Docker containers logs tokens and wall-clock time. Manual: sanity check of 50 random task outputs against the merged PRs (non-empty, non-trivial). Wilcoxon signed-rank test

Criterion: efficiency (tokens, time); no correctness criterion (manual sanity check of 50 outputs that they are non-trivial). Values: Table 1 (mean / median)
- No AGENTS.md + Codex CLI + gpt-5.2-codex (baseline): time 162.94 s / 98.57 s; output tokens 5,744.81 / 2,925.00; input tokens 353,010.01 / 116,609.00; cached input 328,877.31 / 103,424.00; total tokens 687,632.13 / 223,707.00. Quality verdict: not measured (sanity check only); cost verdict: not judged on its own (reference condition, no cost threshold)
- AGENTS.md + Codex CLI + gpt-5.2-codex: time 129.91 s / 70.34 s; output tokens 4,591.46 / 2,440.00; input 318,651.51 / 120,587.00; cached input 296,078.73 / 104,448.00; total 619,321.70 / 226,582.00. Quality verdict: not measured (sanity check only); cost verdict: works (time and output tokens significantly lower; input and total tokens not)

fields.v: Tasks: 124 merged PRs from 10 repos, rebuilt as issue-style task statements generated by gpt-oss-120b from the PR diff and file tree. Configurations: with vs without root AGENTS.md (file removed, all else unchanged). Baseline: without AGENTS.md. Held constant: agent (Codex CLI), model (gpt-5.2-codex), task input, repository snapshot, fresh Docker container per repo, reset between tasks. Acceptance tests: none (no correctness evaluation). Repetitions: Not stated (apparently one run per condition per task). Human intervention: none during runs

AGENTS.md better on efficiency: median wall-clock time -28.64% (98.57 -> 70.34 s), mean -20.27%; median output tokens -16.58% (2,925 -> 2,440), mean -20.08%. Input, cached input and total tokens: means -9.7 to -9.97%, medians -0.99 to -3.41% (slightly higher with AGENTS.md). Significant (Wilcoxon signed-rank, p<0.05) only for wall-clock time and output tokens. Task completion described as 'comparable' (not measured)

Distinguished conditions on time and output tokens, not on total tokens. Repeatability: code, Dockerfiles and generated tasks released; single run per condition, agent stochasticity acknowledged. Limitations stated: one agent and model, sampled repos and small PRs, no correctness evaluation, effects may depend on agent stochasticity

Sampled subset of repositories, PRs and agent configurations; one agent/model; small-scope PRs only; output quality (correctness, maintainability, alignment) not evaluated; future: more agents and models, larger PRs, correctness against merged PRs, properties of AGENTS.md (specificity, structure, workflow guidance), execution-trace analysis of why efficiency improves
